metadata.title: Second Chance at the Billionaire’s Will
metadata.subtitle: My uncle framed me for embezzlement at Grandfather’s 80th banquet and left me to rot in prison. I gasped awake 5 minutes before the forged audit drops.

nodes.text: 7:55 PM · Cold marble beneath your palms. You’re in the Sterling Manor powder room—five minutes before Uncle Victor frames you for stealing $18M.
Audrey, hurry out! Uncle Victor is about to announce Grandfather’s estate gift before the cake!
I know exactly what’s in his briefcase. And this time I know the real thief.
Madison, slip the thumb drive into Audrey’s clutch before the toast.

nodes.transcript: [hushed voice] "Miss Audrey, Master Sterling asked to see you alone in the conservatory before the toast. Something feels wrong."

nodes.prompt: Madison reaches for your evening clutch with a fake smile:

options.label: Keep your clutch locked against your ribs
options.player_reply_text: No thanks, Madison. Keep your hands off my bag tonight.

options.label: Let her plant it, then slip into Victor’s coat

nodes.text: Madison’s fingers freeze an inch from your clasp. Her eyes dart nervously toward Uncle Victor.
Geez, so touchy! I was just fixing your clasp!
You catch her sleight of hand, pull the planted USB out, and drop it smoothly into Victor’s tuxedo jacket as you hug him hello.
What a warm hug, niece. Enjoy your last night as the favorite.
The chandelier dims. Uncle Victor taps his champagne glass—about to drop the forged audit in front of the entire family.
Before Grandfather signs the trust, we need to discuss $18 million missing from the charity ledger—under Audrey’s login!

nodes.headline: The Trap Springs Early
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Cloned Keycard — Two hundred relatives gasp.

nodes.text: 8:05 PM · Two hundred relatives gasp. In your first life, you panicked and shouted—making yourself look guilty. Tonight, you smile.
Don’t deny it! Your CFO badge swiped into the server room at 3:12 AM last Thursday!
Check my flight boarding pass, Uncle. At 3:12 AM Thursday I was over the Atlantic.
Why didn’t anyone tell me she flew to London Thursday?!

nodes.transcript: [steady voice] "I pulled the manor gate logs, Miss Audrey. Someone cloned your spare badge from the mudroom drawer."

nodes.prompt: Grandfather bangs his cane for silence and looks at you:

options.label: Show your airline GPS & customs stamp live
options.player_reply_text: Hard to swipe a basement door in New York from 35,000 feet, Uncle.

options.label: Ask security to pat down Victor’s jacket

nodes.text: Your passport customs stamp flashes onto the banquet projector. Relatives begin whispering against Victor.
Then—then she gave her accomplice the badge! Search her bag!
Security checks Victor’s own pocket first—and pulls out the encrypted USB drive with Madison’s fingerprints on it.
Wait—how did that get in my coat?! Madison!!
Grandfather’s cold gaze shifts from you to Uncle Victor. The banquet hall drops dead silent.
Master Sterling says nobody leaves the estate until we trace where that $18M actually went.

nodes.headline: Lockdown At Sterling Manor
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Macau Wire — You remember the exact bank where Victor hid the embezzled funds to pay off his Macau casino markers..

nodes.text: 8:25 PM · You remember the exact bank where Victor hid the embezzled funds to pay off his Macau casino markers.
The forensic accountant traced $18M through three shell accounts—it’s sitting in an offshore escrow waiting for a final release.
Check the beneficiary name. It’s Dragon Crown Junket—Victor’s private casino debt.
Call the Macau broker! Cancel the wire before the old man’s auditor sees my name!

nodes.transcript: [terrified whisper] "Dad, they’re checking the Wi-Fi logs! My phone connected to the server room at 3:12 AM!"

nodes.caption: Pending $18M offshore transfer screen routed to Dragon Crown casino debt settlement.

nodes.prompt: Victor tries to slip out the patio doors while everyone studies the audit:

options.label: Lock the patio smart-gates from Arthur’s tablet
options.player_reply_text: Going somewhere, Uncle? Your Macau creditors just called back.

options.label: Put the casino collector on speakerphone

nodes.text: The wrought-iron patio doors bolt shut with a heavy clack. Victor rattles the handle helplessly.
Let me out! I was trying to invest that money to double Grandfather’s trust!
A gravelly voice booms through the banquet speakers demanding Victor’s $18M baccarat marker by midnight.
Hang up!! That’s a prank call—somebody turn off the PA system!!
Grandfather’s hand trembles with fury as he tears up Victor’s old power-of-attorney.
Fine! I cloned the badge—because Dad swore Grandfather was cutting us out of the will!

nodes.headline: Confession In The Ballroom
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Poisoned Tea — Wait—a chilling memory flashes back.

nodes.text: 9:00 PM · Wait—a chilling memory flashes back. In your first life, Grandfather died of "heart failure" the very night after the banquet.
Master Sterling is retiring to his library. Madison insisted on brewing his nightly ginseng tea herself.
STOP HER! Do NOT let Grandfather take a single sip of that tea!
Dad, if the old man doesn’t wake up tomorrow, the old will still gives you 40%.

nodes.transcript: [running footsteps] "I’m at the library door—Madison just handed him the porcelain cup!"

nodes.prompt: You sprint into the library as Grandfather lifts the steaming cup:

options.label: Knock the porcelain cup from his hand
options.player_reply_text: Don’t drink it, Grandpa! Test the bottom of that cup right now!

options.label: Force Madison to drink a spoonful herself

nodes.text: Porcelain shatters against the fireplace hearth. A sharp chemical almond odor rises from the carpet.
Are you insane?! You almost scalded Grandfather!!
You hold the spoon to Madison’s lips. She recoils violently and slaps it onto the floor.
Get that away from me!! I—I just used too much herbal root!!
The family doctor dips a test strip into the spilled tea. It turns bright crimson in three seconds.
Digitalis overdose—ten times the lethal dose. Calling the police right now!

nodes.headline: Saved From The Grave
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Basement Escape — Sirens wail up the hill.

nodes.text: 9:30 PM · Sirens wail up the hill. Uncle Victor slips into the wine cellar—heading for the storm drain tunnel he used to smuggle cash.
Victor broke away from security! Motion sensors just tripped in the wine cellar!
He’s going for the old stone drain behind Rack 12. Cut off the ravine exit!
Leave Madison—she’ll get a lighter sentence. Meet me at the marina with the passports!

nodes.transcript: [panting in wet tunnel] "Just five hundred yards to the boat... nobody remembers this drain exists."

nodes.prompt: Rain pours into the ravine as you reach the iron grate first:

options.label: Drop the rusted iron grate & padlock it
options.player_reply_text: Long time no see, Uncle. Enjoy waiting for the detectives in the dark.

options.label: Shine the floodlight & film his cash duffel

nodes.text: The iron grate slams shut inches from Victor’s face. Two detectives slide down the muddy bank behind you.
Audrey! Open this gate—I’m your father’s brother!!
Your floodlight catches Victor clutching a duffel stuffed with $2M in bearer bonds stolen from Grandfather’s safe.
Turn that light off!! Those bonds were my inheritance!!
Handcuffs click shut in the rain. Victor’s scheme to steal the Sterling fortune dies in the mud.
Wait, Miss Audrey—Victor’s phone just got a text from someone INSIDE the boardroom. He wasn’t working alone!

nodes.headline: The Mole Inside The Board
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Silent Partner — A burner text on Victor’s seized phone reads: "Plan B active.

nodes.text: 10:15 PM · A burner text on Victor’s seized phone reads: "Plan B active. Short Sterling stock at open." You recognize the phrasing immediately.
That burner only texted one board member’s private number: Director Hayes—your father’s oldest friend.
In my first life, Hayes bought Sterling Corp for pennies while I was in prison.
Hayes, if you bail me out, I’ll sign over the remaining shares.

nodes.transcript: [grim voice] "Hayes just leaked a fake rumor that Master Sterling passed away tonight. Asian markets are already panicking!"

nodes.prompt: Sterling Corp futures drop 14% in pre-market trading:

options.label: Stream Grandfather alive & well from the patio
options.player_reply_text: Sorry to ruin your short sale, Director Hayes. Grandpa’s having chamomile.

options.label: Buy back 2M shorted shares before going live

nodes.text: Grandfather waves cheerfully on live financial TV. The rumor dies in ninety seconds.
Stock just snapped back +18%! Hayes’s short sellers are getting crushed!
You quietly scoop up Hayes’s panic-dumped shares at a 15% discount—then broadcast Grandfather’s live interview.
You just squeezed Hayes out of $30M in ten minutes flat!!
Across town, Director Hayes’s hedge fund triggers an automatic margin call.
Hayes is demanding an emergency proxy battle at 9 AM. He thinks he still has three directors in his pocket.

nodes.headline: War At The Opening Bell
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Midnight Bribe — Hayes meets two swing directors at the Grand Meridian bar to buy their votes.

nodes.text: 11:40 PM · Hayes meets two swing directors at the Grand Meridian bar to buy their votes. You remember the exact booth from your first life’s trial transcripts.
Our spotter confirmed Hayes is in Booth 4 handing out Swiss bank envelopes.
Send the financial regulator’s tip line straight to Booth 4.
Hayes, don’t leave me hanging in county lockup! Tell them I didn’t touch the tea!

nodes.transcript: [low whisper] "Wait—one of the directors in Booth 4 is recording Hayes on his own watch! He’s flipping to our side!"

nodes.prompt: Hayes texts you smugly thinking he locked the 9 AM vote:

options.label: Reply with a photo of Booth 4’s wine bill
options.player_reply_text: Lovely Pinot Noir at Booth 4, Director. Hope the regulators like it too.

options.label: Wait until the boardroom meeting to drop it

nodes.text: Hayes drops his wine glass in the bar and sprints for the valet.
He knows he’s burned! Two swing directors just pledged their proxies to you!
You stay silent all night—letting Hayes stroll into Sterling Tower thinking he’s won, right into federal investigators.
Both swing directors handed over the watch recordings. Hayes is done!
Dawn breaks over Sterling Tower. Every traitor who buried you in your first life is cornered.
Wait—security just flagged two dark silhouettes entering the basement archive room at 1:15 AM!

nodes.headline: Intruders In The Archive
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Archive Arson — Hayes’s hired thugs broke into the basement archive to burn the original 1995 founding charter before the morning vote..

nodes.text: 1:20 AM · Hayes’s hired thugs broke into the basement archive to burn the original 1995 founding charter before the morning vote.
CCTV caught two masked men pouring solvent near Vault B! Fire alarms were disabled!
Trigger the Halon gas fire suppression manually from the security desk!
Hayes, if you burn the archive you burn the land deeds too!!

nodes.transcript: [alarm klaxon wailing] "Halon doors sealed! The two arsonists are coughing and banging on the glass—police are 2 minutes out!"

nodes.caption: Basement Archive CCTV · 01:18 AM — two masked silhouettes trapped outside Vault B before fire suppression.

nodes.text: [alarm blaring] "Smoke detectors just tripped in Basement Archive B! Two men in masks are pouring accelerant by the ledger vault—security is 30 seconds out!"
EMERGENCY: Smoke alarms just triggered in Archive B! Masked men are at the ledger vault—tell me your move!

nodes.prompt: The arsonists beg through the intercom for the door override:

options.label: Hold the doors sealed until police arrive
options.player_reply_text: Give me who hired you on camera and I’ll crack the vent.

options.label: Open the outer door straight into SWAT

nodes.text: Both men blurt out Director Hayes’s private cell number directly into the security mic.
Clear confession on audio AND video! The 1995 charter wasn’t even singed!
You time the unlock to the exact second officers storm the corridor—tackling both suspects with the gas cans in hand.
Red-handed with Hayes’s burner phone in his pocket!
By 2:00 AM, Director Hayes’s arrest warrant is signed by a night-duty judge.
Grandfather just woke up—he wants the real will read at 9 AM sharp, in front of the entire board.

nodes.headline: The Real Will Awakens
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The 9 AM Reckoning — Sterling Tower’s 40th floor.

nodes.text: 8:55 AM · Sterling Tower’s 40th floor. Grandfather sits at the head of the table, healthy and razor-sharp. Every seat is filled—except Victor’s and Hayes’s.
Police just escorted Hayes out of the ground lobby in handcuffs. The board is completely silent.
Let’s open the real trust and end three generations of parasites.
Audrey, please tell Grandpa I’m sorry—my lawyer says I’m facing 15 years!

nodes.transcript: [solemn pride] "Master Sterling is transferring 62% voting control and the Chairwoman seat directly to Audrey."

nodes.prompt: Grandfather slides the heavy brass company seal toward you:

options.label: Accept & pledge zero tolerance for corruption
options.player_reply_text: I accept, Grandpa. Every stolen dollar goes back to our employees’ pension fund.

options.label: Audit every offshore subsidiary starting today

nodes.text: Applause erupts around the 30-foot table. Even the strictest institutional investors stand.
The employee union just endorsed your appointment unanimously!
Your instant audit uncovers three more hidden kickback accounts—saving the company $14M before lunch.
Half the old cronies just resigned before you even reached their floor!
Grandfather squeezes your hand gently. "You grew a steel spine overnight, my dear."
Wait—Madison’s mother just showed up in the lobby threatening to sue unless we drop the poisoning charge!

nodes.headline: One Last Viper
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Aunt’s Bluff — Victor’s wife brings a tabloid crew to the lobby, weeping for cameras that you "framed her innocent family.".

nodes.text: 11:10 AM · Victor’s wife brings a tabloid crew to the lobby, weeping for cameras that you "framed her innocent family."
She’s livestreaming from the fountain claiming you poisoned Grandfather yourself to seize the shares!
Perfect. Bring the lab report and Madison’s confession video down to the lobby.
Mom, STOP talking to reporters! They have the kitchen CCTV of me pouring the drops!!

nodes.transcript: [crisp tone] "The lobby LED wall is synced to your tablet, Chairwoman. Ready on your signal."

nodes.prompt: Your aunt points at you dramatically for the cameras:

options.label: Play the lab toxicology report on the LED wall
options.player_reply_text: Since you love cameras, let’s show everyone the digitalis test from Grandpa’s tea.

options.label: Serve her a $5M defamation suit live on air

nodes.text: The 20-foot lobby LED wall flashes the police toxicology stamp and Madison’s voice confession.
The tabloid crew immediately spins their cameras straight onto your aunt’s horrified face!
Your general counsel hands her the defamation summons right in front of 200,000 livestream viewers.
She dropped her own microphone and ran straight into a taxi!
Within an hour, Sterling Corp’s reputation hits an all-time high.
The prosecutor called—Victor and Hayes both pleaded guilty to avoid maximum life sentences.

nodes.headline: Total Surrender
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Recovery — One month later.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · One month later. Every cent of the $18M is recovered, and Grandfather celebrates his clean bill of health in the rose garden.
The medical board confirmed Master Sterling’s heart is stronger than it’s been in five years!
That’s the only victory I cared about when I woke up in that powder room.
Tell my father I’m sorry... I lost my way at the tables.

nodes.transcript: [warm voice] "The charity foundation you rebuilt just funded three new pediatric wings in Master Sterling’s name."

nodes.prompt: Grandfather hands you a sealed envelope from his personal safe:

options.label: Open it together in the rose garden
options.player_reply_text: Whatever it is, Grandpa, the best gift is still having you here.

options.label: Promise to expand the scholarship globally

nodes.text: Inside is your grandmother’s handwritten letter: "Trust the one who protects the family when the lights go out."
Grandfather is wiping away tears—he knows he chose the right heir!
You sign the global scholarship charter right on the garden table, turning a family war into a lasting legacy.
Three generations of Sterling history just got a brand-new chapter!
Golden evening light bathes Sterling Manor. No poison, no prison cell—only peace earned through fire.
Dinner is served on the terrace, Chairwoman. Shall I ring the bell?

nodes.headline: One Last Toast
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Heir By Right — The terrace overlooks the glittering city skyline.

nodes.text: 7:00 PM · The terrace overlooks the glittering city skyline. You raise a glass of clean sparkling cider with Grandfather.
To the Chairwoman who turned a five-minute warning into a lifetime of justice!
And to never letting greed sit at our family table again.
I hope you’re happy—you took everything from us.

nodes.transcript: [gentle laugh] "Ignore the prison mail, Miss Audrey. Your future starts right here."

nodes.prompt: Grandfather lifts his glass for your first official family toast:

options.label: Toast to Grandfather’s 90th birthday next
options.player_reply_text: To ten more birthdays together, Grandpa—and zero snakes in the garden.

options.label: Ring the terrace bell to launch the new era

nodes.text: Laughter rings across the terrace as lanterns glow over the rose garden.
Best 80th birthday turn-around I’ve ever witnessed in forty years of service!
The brass bell chimes cleanly into the night sky, sealing your triumph forever.
Sterling Corp is in the safest hands it has ever known!
You glance once at your reflection in the glass—no longer the prisoner they framed, but the sovereign they feared.
Five minutes was all it took to save my grandfather—and take back my crown.

nodes.headline: The Crown Restored · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Every dollar of the $18M returned to Sterling Tower — the rightful heir finally claims the skyline.
